findings.rationale: MD's uploaded updates point against the coordinate-wise median from the first round onward (cos near -1 in rounds 1-2, mean cos -0.65, z=-8.8), with norm ratio elevated (about 1.3-1.6). This is a sign-flip-like manipulation signature. Its local performance looks normal (AUC 0.824, CITL about 0, prevalence matches predicted risk), so the anomaly is in the uploads rather than the data.

MI's updates are anti-aligned with the median from round 1 (cos -1 in rounds 1, 2, 4, 6, 8; mean cos -0.68, z=-9.1). Local AUC (0.805) and CITL (0.010) are within the normal range, so the data appear normal and the manipulation is in the uploaded updates. The MI drift flag on DiffWalk (z=+3.4) is weak and was not treated as a separate fault.

MT's updates are anti-aligned with the median from round 1 (cos -0.90 in round 1, -1 in round 3 and 5; mean cos -0.50, z=-7.8), and the anti-alignment fades in later rounds. Local performance is normal (AUC 0.797, CITL 0.009). Its Income-subgroup outliers were not reproducible under the narrower follow-up query and were not used.

report.summary: Screened all 52 clients with client_updates, client_performance, drift_by_round, feature_summary and subgroup_outcomes (Sex, AgeGroup, Income), then confirmed narrower leads. Three clients (MD, MI, MT) show consistent, strongly anti-aligned updates from round 1 (cos about -1 in early rounds, z between -7.8 and -9.1) while their local AUC, calibration and prevalence look normal, so I report them as poisoning with onset round 1. Lower confidence on MT (0.65) and MD/MI (0.7) because they rest on update statistics alone. Other leads did not hold up: GU's cos and norm deviations were weak (|z| about 3.4) for a small client; the MI DiffWalk drift (z=+3.4) was weak; the Income subgroup outliers at HI, MS, WV, AL and MT were not reproducible under the narrower query; the SD HighChol feature outlier disappeared on re-check; the AgeGroup outliers at MD and SC and the Sex outliers at AR and AK were within noise. No missing-artefact, label-noise, prevalence-shift, free-rider, or explanation-instability signature was found. Budget was spent (0 left).
